events.title: Tupac Shakur Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: Rapper Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas on this day in 1996, he would have been 55.

angles.name: Remembering Tupac
angles.copy: We remember the immense talent and lasting impact of Tupac Shakur, a hip-hop icon whose voice continues to resonate.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix tragically passed away on this day in 1970, he would have been 84.

angles.name: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled talent of Jimi Hendrix, a true guitar hero who redefined rock music forever.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Legacy
angles.copy: The album cover, the tracks, the legacy – The Beatles' Abbey Road remains an absolute masterpiece.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the legendary Chrissie Hynde – still rocking as hard as ever with The Pretenders.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher – still a true rock and roll star. As you were!

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine's Enduring Message
angles.copy: A song that still resonates globally with its message of peace and unity, John Lennon's 'Imagine' was released on this day.

events.title: First iPod Released Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the very first iPod, revolutionising portable music, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? The first iPod dropped on this day, changing how we listen to music forever.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Happy James Bond Day
angles.copy: Grab your martini, shaken not stirred – it's James Bond Day! Who's your favourite Bond?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today would have marked the 86th birthday of The Beatles legend, John Lennon.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary artist and peacemaker, John Lennon, on what would have been his 86th birthday.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedic icon and Monty Python star John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese – a true master of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Masterpiece
angles.copy: A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece – The Beatles' 'White Album' dropped on this day in '68. Which track is your favourite?

events.title: Freddie Mercury Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: The world remembers Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991, he would have been 80.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie Mercury
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, whose voice and stage presence remain legendary. We miss him.

events.title: The Beatles' Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Turning Point
angles.copy: Often cited as a turning point in their musical evolution, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' arrived on this day.
